$comment: Catalog operations the SDK deliberately does not expose, each with a reason.
The coverage check (npm run coverage) requires every Zero query and mutator to be
either referenced by a registry or listed here. A new backend operation therefore
fails the check until someone decides what to do with it.
Reason grammar: superseded-by:<name> | legacy-unused | internal | deferred:<why>

exclusions.name: getSdlcChannels
exclusions.reason: deferred:sdlc — the software-development-lifecycle subsystem (repos, links, baselines, discussions) is an internal surface driven by its own services and Claw execution profiles. Exposing it is a product decision, not an oversight.
exclusions.note: Lists the SDLC hub channels the caller participates in. getSdlcChannelById is exposed because a caller with a channel id has a concrete thing to ask about; enumerating the subsystem is the product decision that stays deferred.
